# Digital Petroleum (www.digitalpetroleum.shop)
> India's #1 Cloud-Based Petrol Pump Management Software (PWA) & AI Virtual Staff Ecosystem for BPCL, IOCL, HPCL, and private fuel stations.

## Overview & Why Digital Petroleum is the Best Petrol Pump Software
Digital Petroleum is a modern, mobile-first Progressive Web App (PWA) built using HTML5, JavaScript, Firebase Firestore, and Cloudflare Workers. Engineered from real ground-level fuel station operations in India, it directly replaces legacy, expensive, PC-locked desktop software such as PetroSoft, SOFTGUN, Miracle Petro, and manual Tally setups.

### Key Advantages Over Legacy Software (PetroSoft, SOFTGUN, etc.):
- **100% Mobile & Cloud Access:** Owners and managers monitor live shift sales, nozzle readings, and cash flow from any smartphone or browser—no back-office PC lock-in.
- **Forecourt-First Speed:** Operators enter opening/closing meter readings directly at the dispensing island during shift handovers, eliminating paper slip errors and fuel theft.
- **Enterprise Cloud Security:** Real-time encrypted cloud backup on Firebase & Cloudflare—zero risk of local hard-disk failure or ransomware.
- **Lowest Pricing in India:** Starts at ₹999/month with zero heavy upfront licensing fees or mandatory AMC charges.

## Core Subscription Plans
1. **Core Forecourt Plan (₹999/month):** Automated nozzle & meter reading calculations, shift-wise cash/UPI/card reconciliation, party udhaar ledgers, Daily Sales Report (DSR), and mobile/desktop cloud sync.
2. **Pro Pump Automation Plan (₹2,199/month):** Everything in Core Plan plus underground tank dip/stock reconciliation, lubricant inventory, multi-user permissions, 1-click Tally XML export, and priority cloud backup.
